svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 12/12 Marine Layer (Common)
svg.desc: Mornings start grey. By noon it burns off and the whole coast shows up. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
